meta.tagline: Endgame era: Torment climb · unique chase · Mythic crafting.
meta.plan: Both at 70 on the endgame builds (starter variants). Tick each aspect, affix and temper as drops land. Finish the paragon board, complete the gear card, then move up a variant. Bloodied Butcher drops BOTH chase weapons — farm him together.

guide.title: Torment climb
guide.html:
• Clear Pit 10 → unlocks Torment 1 → ancestral drops begin.
  • Sanctum's 70+ flow: gear catch-up (PvP-area chests) → temper/enchant everything → unlock Torments → farm Maggots in Torment 3 until the paragon legendary nodes are in → push. He reckons ~Torment 10 inside 10 hours.
  • Move up a Torment as soon as it feels comfortable — higher tiers = better gear odds. Stay on the same tier as each other.
  • S14 Torment count unverified — Cliptis's filters mention T12; confirm the actual ladder in-game.

guide.title: Farming loop (paragon XP & mats)
guide.html:
• Helltide Maggot farm still pays post-70 for paragon XP: War Plan Helltide nodes (4 = Maggots possible, 14 = guaranteed), ride between Wyrm spawns, Threat Meter above half. Helltides.com is the map.
  • One-chest rule: chests give no XP — open one, move on; spend Cinders only when you need gear.
  • Whispers stack on top of Helltide objectives for free XP.
  • Undercity (solo bursts): Attunement Ranks drop XP globes (1/2/3/4 per rank) — they are NOT auto-collected. From Rank 4: pure boss-sprints.
  • PvP-area chests (Sanctum): fast gear catch-up whenever your gear lags.
  • Boss rotation: Bloodied Butcher (both weapons!), Bartuc (Tuskhelm), Grigoire (Gohr's), Astaroth (Griswold's Opus), Corrupted Reaper in Zarbinzet (Mythics + Fragments).

guide.title: S14: Death Awakening
guide.html:
The seasonal loop runs through Helltides — it layers onto the farming loop for free. Start quest: A Gospel of Despair (scroll in Kyovashad) if we haven't yet.

  • Pandemonium Ruptures: rifts, most frequent in Helltides — kill the guardians at Death's Head Idols. Longer open = more rewards. Rupture Goblins open extras anywhere.
  • Colossal Ruptures (Fields of Desecration, SE of Zarbinzet) guarantee a Realmwalker → Deathtoll Chamber → best Superior Lair Keys. Now worth chasing (we skipped while leveling).
  • Glints of Hope → rep board in Zarbinzet. Pandemonium Fragments (rep board, Resplendent Caches, Seasonal Lair Boss) → Mythic crafting fuel.
  • Season Blessing: Urn of Death Awakening (more Glints) with Smoldering Ashes.
  • The Risen: intercept Gravehound orbs before they empower the Exarch.

guide.title: Horadric cube · crafting Mythics
guide.html:
Mythic Uniques 3.0: any Unique can become Mythic.

  • Craft at level 70 in Torment+ via Horadric Cube → Upgrade to Mythic.
  • Recipe: 850+ Unique of the same slot + 5 Pandemonium Fragments.
  • Only one crafted Mythic equipped at a time (dropped/cache ones unlimited).
  • Corrupted Reaper (Zarbinzet) has the best Mythic + Fragment drops.
  • Keep every 850+ Unique in the right slot as craft fodder.

The chase: Melted Heart of Selig, Ring of Starless Skies, The Grandfather (Landi) · Mythic Crown of Lucion + Mythic Fists of Fate (Nolan).

guide.title: Co-op synergy (WW + Zeal)
guide.html:
• The auras still carry: Nolan's Fanaticism (offense) + Defiance (defense) buff Landi in range — stay close.
  • Fortress is the anchor: Nolan drops Fortress zones for his damage buff — Landi, whirlwind through the same pack he's standing in.
  • Both melee now: stack on the same target; Nolan is the unkillable Resolve wall, Landi the mobile shredder.
  • Vulnerable: at later Zeal variants Condemn returns (groups + Vulnerable). Until then Landi's own sources carry it.
  • Shared boss target: Bloodied Butcher drops Ramaladni's (Landi) AND Red Sermon (Nolan) — every kill is a two-for-one lottery ticket.
  • Mercs: both run Raheir (hired) + Aldkin (reinforcement) — that's fine, mercs are per-player.

guide.title: Syncing War Plans
guide.html:
Still the procedure whenever we re-plan:

  1. Both have War Plans unlocked (Skovos).
  2. Be in an actual party.
  3. Both stand in Temis at the board.
  4. Pick “New Plan For Party” (only appears when partied).
  5. Initiator pays 2 Marks of El'Druin; the other player must accept the vote popup.
  6. Board resets and copies to both.

guide.title: Variant ladder — how we progress
guide.html:
• Landi (WW): Legendary (now) → Uniques → Mythic → Selig. Legendary carries into Torment 2–3 with zero uniques.
  • Nolan (Zeal): Starter (now, sword+board) → Endgame (Crown of Lucion + Red Sermon, goes 2H) → Mythic speedfarm.
  • The rule (from the Zeal guide): finished all paragon points + gear card ticked → move to the next variant.
  • When either of you is ready to move up: send fresh Mobalytics screenshots of the next variant and the app gets updated — ticks for unchanged pieces carry over.

Auto-cast trick: Rally/auras can auto-cast via the Numlock trick (bind to numpad, hold, toggle Numlock, release) — PC only; on Xbox just keep casting on cooldown.
Resolve: Fortress generates tons; 20 Max Resolve = 100% Block; stack Max Resolve tempers (armor slots).
Attack speed breakpoints: exist (60fps server frames) but 'not found yet' for Zeal — check the build page later.
